title: Close the holes in the CSRF guard
acceptanceCriteria: `GET`, `HEAD` and `OPTIONS` pass; `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH` and `DELETE` from another site are rejected
With `Sec-Fetch-Site`, only `same-origin` is accepted; `same-site`, `cross-site` and `none` are rejected
Without `Sec-Fetch-Site`, `Origin` must exactly equal a trusted origin; `https://app.example.com.evil.test`, `https://app.example.co` and `null` are rejected
A state-changing request with neither header is rejected
`sessionCookie` sets `HttpOnly`, `Secure` and an explicit `SameSite=Lax`, and keeps the value, `Path=/` and `Max-Age`
